body:
Plan chat, 30 Oct. Tonight is cut down so it can finish in one night.
IN tonight (all already decided):
- Max 10 pets; only your 3 chosen pets follow you, the rest stay home.
- Give a pet away to the pet shop cashier.
- Interior designer: new orders are 1 room; a saved 2-room order still finishes. Check line N8: old 'tests a 2-room order' -> new 'new orders 1 room; saved 2-room order still finishes'.
- Morning bus home from the beach every day 8:00-9:30 (approved).
- Hats sitting inside hair: fix on all hats and cosmetics.
NOT tonight: pet brain (moves not OK'd; critic stuck at 6/10 because models have stiff legs), backyard, new pets, Pet Show, farm, night skip, pet redraws, model pack.
How: one Claude Code chat on cute-games/cozy-town, Opus 5.5 medium. Backup branch backup-2026-10-30 first. Quick kit after each change, full check before the pull request. Karolis merges in the morning.

comments.text: Replaced: Karolis wants the full Pets and Farm Update, not a cut-down night.
